title: Hazel as an npm Package, Then and Now
blurb: Report 063's questions and charts, asked again four days later of hazeljs 0.0.14, the first version on npm with hazel-jit. On each game's own run of states, the package's jit now takes 0.32 of the time of each game's compiled.js, where it took 0.91 on 11-24 and, on 11-23's repeated operations, 7.50 times, and runs 4,148 times as fast as the interpreter. Gnome world's whole speed run takes 6% longer with every piece Hazel's than with every piece in JavaScript; World.step alone 5.3 times plain JavaScript's time, 4.0 with the night's trials. Building the rules is still seconds, nearly all Hazel's type checker: two open statics PRs bring Gnome world's warm build from about 3.2 s to 0.33 s, and its rules now ship compiled ahead of time. Then the decisions before dev, as the 11-27 meeting left them.
